authorization: Current owner request to extract, review and publish the reusable skill in the named catalogs.
canonical_selection: One public-neutral read-only source contract; adjacent drafting, career-addendum and application-status packages retain their distinct jobs.
exclusions: Runtime messages, private locators, transcripts and career files.
Unrelated branches, legacy source snapshots and host configuration.
verification: Full relative-file inventory and SHA-256 equality; YAML metadata type, references, synthetic-fixture and neutrality checks.
recovery: The new package is absent at the recorded base commits. Revert only this task's commits after inspecting later changes; do not discard other work or private runtime records.
historical_limit: This records current reviewed bytes and the directly observed pre-copy task state. It does not reconstruct earlier approvals or establish live host compatibility.
